description: Presidential Secretariat - Duties and Functions of the non - Cabinet Ministers
categorisation: This gazette notification names President Maithripala Sirisena as the authority making ministerial assignments and provides detailed portfolio responsibilities for Non-Cabinet Ministers (including specific duties, functions, departments, statutory institutions, public corporations, and laws to be implemented). The content contains both the "who" (the President and the ministerial positions) and the "what" (detailed subject matter responsibilities), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
